$comment: VALUES the loop reads, nothing else. A tuning change should be a data edit reviewable on its own, so this file holds numbers, names and ids — never rules and never rationale. The rule lives in the skill that enforces it; the story lives in docs/why.md. Read fresh from main on every routine run, so merging a change here changes the next run with no redeploy.

ceilings.$comment: Stock caps and per-run backstops. Never a per-run flow quota: at 8 runs/day a 'per run' allowance is 8x a daily one. Rules in work-routine/SKILL.md.

labels.$comment: Two labels. journal excludes the diary from every worklist; awaiting is the primary human-attention signal, written by the state-machine workflow and — for four dead ends only — by the loop. Rules in triage-issue/SKILL.md.

assignment.$comment: assignee:<bot> IS the worklist and only the user writes it; the loop may only ever remove itself. respondTo is the allowlist of logins whose comments count as feedback. Rules in triage-issue/SKILL.md.

mergePolicy.$comment: Repos where the loop may open and revise PRs but must never merge them, whatever the gate says. claude-workflow ships the instructions every run is executing, so merging there is the deploy and belongs to a human — and now that the repo is ticketless, review is the ONLY gate its changes pass.

surveyCalendar.$comment: Weekday -> survey skill, dispatched by survey-routine only. Saturday runs no survey. Keys are lowercase UTC weekday names as produced by `date -u +%A | tr A-Z a-z`.

analysisAngles: feature research against current best practice

sentry.$comment: DE region: the global sentry.io host 404s for these projects. Token has no org:read, so /organizations/ 403s — expected. SahajAtlasWordpress ships no Sentry.

mailpit.$comment: Basic-auth credentials live in the cloud environment as MAILPIT_UI_AUTH, never here.

issueFields.$comment: GitHub's native org-level issue fields — not Projects v2, not labels. Readable and writable, NOT searchable. Read/write rules and the PUT-replaces-everything gotcha are in triage-issue/SKILL.md.

relationships.$comment: No MCP tool reads blocked_by, so a cloud run reads this marker from the issue body instead. Set the real relationship locally AND mirror it here.
relationships.recheckProbe: select:mcp__github__issue_dependency_read — if this ever resolves, switch work-routine to the tool and retire the body-marker fallback

identity.$comment: expectedLogin is authoritative and is checked against get_me once per run. Attribution rules in work-routine/SKILL.md.
identity.commentMarker: <sub>🤖 Written by the sydevs autonomous loop — see [what this is](https://github.com/sydevs/claude-workflow#the-loop)</sub>

review.$comment: Rung 5 / adversarial-review. Advisory only. Rules in adversarial-review/SKILL.md.

journal.$comment: One issue per day in journalRepo, created lazily. The title reports run health; volume lives on the board. No issue number here on purpose: the run finds today's by creation date.

projects.$comment: The org workflow board — a lens over Stage, awaiting and PR review state; the loop NEVER reads or writes it. Story in docs/why.md#the-board-is-a-lens.
projects.recheckProbe: select:mcp__github__projects_list — probed ABSENT 2026-09-03 (session cse_0188Trog41g4Zt2j9oQS9crB); if this ever resolves from a routine, Projects v2 became reachable

stateMachine.$comment: The workflow that owns every mechanical Stage/assignee/awaiting transition. Values only; the division of labour is in preflight/SKILL.md and docs/why.md#the-state-machine-is-not-the-loops-job.

writing.$comment: Character budgets for everything the loop writes, counted INCLUDING <details>. Bodies are deliberately unbudgeted: they are state, and grounding reads them instead of the thread. Enforced by workflow/lib/budget.mjs; rules in preflight/SKILL.md.
